text.aria-label: Title text 'Safe-side share by phase of an injected load-shift: 15 and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead Safe side: below q95 if the shift lowered the load, above q05 if it raised it. Dashed: the 0.95 target. Scored against the NRA, an estimate.'
text.tspan: Safe-side share by phase of an injected load-shift: 15 and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead
Safe side: below q95 if the shift lowered the load, above q05 if it raised it. Dashed: the 0.95 target. Scored against the NRA, an estimate.
